intentAndPurpose.intent: Transient feedback toast with semantic type (default/loading/positive/negative/warning/info), visual attention (high/medium/low), announcement priority, optional leading visual, up to two actions, progress, and dismiss. Use ToastProvider + ToastViewport with createToastManager / useToastManager for managed stacks; display-only Toast renders a single static toast.

props.name: title
props.description: Primary message. A description-only toast is valid.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Tertiary helper copy at the bottom of the toast (below progress when present).

props.name: type
props.description: Figma semantic/visual type. Appearance role is derived from type.

props.name: attention
props.description: Visual prominence only (surface mode: bold / subtle / elevated).

props.name: start
props.description: Leading visual. Pass false to hide the type-derived default visual.

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to two action nodes, or structured { label, onPress, closeOnPress?, disabled? } descriptors.

props.name: actionsPlacement
props.description: Whether actions sit beside or below the text.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether the dismiss control is visible.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Auto-dismiss timeout when published through a manager. Zero is persistent.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Display-only Toast callback. Managed ToastItem instances close through their manager.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline native styles on the root wrapper.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Hint describing the toast action outcome.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name override; otherwise derived from title/description/helperText.
